extracted.intended_audience: dataset creators, ML researchers/practitioners, and public health students/practitioners who document datasets for machine learning
extracted.subtask_description: Create a Datasheet for a dataset by answering a standard set of disclosure questions covering motivation, composition, collection, preprocessing/labeling, intended uses, distribution, and maintenance — with emphasis on transparency and risks in ML and public health contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: For what purpose was the dataset created? Was there a specific task in mind? Was there a specific gap that needed to be filled?

rubrics_metrics.name: Entity affiliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Who created the dataset and on behalf of which entity? Which team(s) or research group(s) on behalf of which entity (company, institution, organization(s))?

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Who funded the creation of the dataset? If there is an associated grant, provide the name of the grantor and the grant name and number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other comments (Motivation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any additional commentary related to motivation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance representation
rubrics_metrics.description: What do the instances that comprise the dataset represent (documents, photos, people, countries)? Are there multiple types of instances (e.g., films and ratings; people and interactions; nodes and edges)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of instances
rubrics_metrics.description: How many instances are there in total by type?

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample and population specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the dataset contain all possible instances or is it a sample of instances from a larger set? If the dataset is a sample, then what is the larger set? Is the sample representative of the larger set?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how representativeness was validated/verified. If not representative, explain why (intentional oversampling, unavailability, etc.). Provide rationale such as geographic coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data explication
rubrics_metrics.description: What data does each instance consist of? Raw data (e.g., unprocessed text or images) or features?

rubrics_metrics.name: Labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Is there a label or target associated with each instance?

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing data
rubrics_metrics.description: Is any information missing from individual instances? If so, explain why (e.g., not available, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: This does not include intentionally removed information, but may include e.g., redacted text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Are relationships between individual instances made explicit (e.g., before and after intervention)? Provide a description.

rubrics_metrics.name: Splitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Are there recommended data splits for training, development/validation, testing? Provide a description of these splits, explaining the rationale behind them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Errors, noise, and redundancies
rubrics_metrics.description: Are there any errors, sources of noise, or redundancies in the dataset?

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-contained vs. externally reliant
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the dataset self-contained, or does it link to or otherwise rely on external resources (e.g., websites, tweets, other datasets)?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If it links/relies on external resources, address: guarantees they will exist and remain constant over time; availability of official archival versions of the complete dataset (including externals as they existed when created); any restrictions (licenses, fees) associated with external resources that might apply to dataset consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality & Privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the dataset contain data that might be considered confidential or private, legally or otherwise (e.g., data protected by legal privilege; individuals’ non-public communications)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional implications
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the dataset contain data that, if viewed directly, might be offensive, insulting, threatening, or might otherwise cause anxiety?

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the dataset include information about age, gender, etc.? Provide the respective characteristic distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Is it possible to identify individuals directly or indirectly (e.g., in combination with other data) from the dataset?

rubrics_metrics.name: Content sensitivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the dataset contain data that might be considered sensitive in any way (e.g., race or ethnic origins, sexual orientations, religious beliefs, political opinions or union memberships, locations; financial or health data; biometric or genetic data; government IDs; criminal history)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Other comments (Composition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any additional commentary related to composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection methods
rubrics_metrics.description: How was the data associated with each instance acquired? Was the data directly observable, reported by individuals, or indirectly inferred/derived from other data? Were the data validated/verified?

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection apparatus
rubrics_metrics.description: What mechanisms or procedures were used to collect the data (hardware/sensors, manual human curation, software programs, APIs, etc.)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Sampling strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: If the dataset is a sample from a larger set, what was the sampling strategy (deterministic, probabilistic with specific sampling probabilities, etc.)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Data curation and collection labor
rubrics_metrics.description: Who was involved in the data collection or curation process (students, crowdworkers, contractors, etc.) and how were they compensated for their time?

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: Over what timeframe was the data collected? Does this timeframe correspond to the creation timeframe of the data associated with the instances (e.g., recent crawl of old news articles)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical review
rubrics_metrics.description: Were any ethical review processes conducted (by an institutional review board, etc.)? Provide a description of the processes and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual/participant involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Did you collect the data from the individuals in question directly, or obtain it via third parties or other sources (websites, etc.)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual/participant notification
rubrics_metrics.description: Were individuals whose data appear in the dataset notified about the data collection?

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual/participant consent
rubrics_metrics.description: Did the individuals whose data appear in the dataset consent to the collection and use of these data?

rubrics_metrics.name: Consent revocation
rubrics_metrics.description: If consent was obtained, were the consenting individuals provided with a mechanism to revoke their consent in the future or for certain uses?

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Has an analysis of the potential impact of the dataset and its use on data subjects (data protection impact analysis, etc.) been conducted? If so, provide a description of analysis and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other comments (Collection Process)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any additional commentary related to collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preprocessing methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Was any preprocessing/cleaning/labeling of the data done (e.g., discretization or bucketing, tokenization, POS tagging, SIFT feature extraction, removal of instances, processing of missing values)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Raw data availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Was the raw data saved in addition to the preprocessed/cleaned/labeled data for provenance or to support unanticipated future uses?

rubrics_metrics.name: Preprocessing software
rubrics_metrics.description: What software was used to preprocess, clean, and label the data?

rubrics_metrics.name: Other comments (Preprocessing, Cleaning, & Labeling)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any additional commentary related to preprocessing/cleaning/labeling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior use
rubrics_metrics.description: What known tasks has the dataset been used for already?

rubrics_metrics.name: Use repository
rubrics_metrics.description: Is there a public repository that links to any or all papers or systems that use the dataset?

rubrics_metrics.name: Other uses
rubrics_metrics.description: What other tasks could the dataset be used for?

rubrics_metrics.name: Preprocessing impact on use
rubrics_metrics.description: Is there anything about the composition of the dataset or the way it was collected and preprocessed/cleaned/labeled that might impact future uses?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe anything a dataset consumer might need to know to avoid uses that could result in unfair treatment of individuals or groups (e.g., stereotyping, quality-of-service issues) or other risks/harms (legal, financial). Suggest mitigations dataset consumers could take.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Are there tasks for which the dataset should not be used?

rubrics_metrics.name: Other comments (Uses)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any additional commentary related to uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: External distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Will the dataset be distributed to third parties outside of the entity on behalf of which the dataset was created?

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution methods
rubrics_metrics.description: How will the dataset be distributed (tarball, API, GitHub repo, etc.)? Does the dataset have a DOI?

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution time
rubrics_metrics.description: When will the dataset be distributed?

rubrics_metrics.name: Curating entity proprietorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Will the dataset be distributed under a copyright or other IP license, and/or under applicable terms of use? If so, describe the license/ToU and provide links or reproduce relevant terms, and any fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party proprietorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Have any third parties imposed IP-based or other restrictions on the data associated with the instances?

rubrics_metrics.name: Export controls and regulatory restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Do any export controls or other regulatory restrictions apply to the dataset or to individual instances?

rubrics_metrics.name: Other comments (Distribution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any additional commentary related to distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset hosting
rubrics_metrics.description: Who will be supporting/hosting/maintaining the dataset?

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact
rubrics_metrics.description: How can the owner/curator/manager of the dataset be contacted?

rubrics_metrics.name: Erratum
rubrics_metrics.description: Is there an erratum associated with this dataset?

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Will the dataset be updated (e.g., to correct labeling errors, add new instances, delete instances)? If so, how often, by whom, and how will updates be communicated to dataset consumers (mailing list, GitHub, etc.)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Retention & Disposition
rubrics_metrics.description: If the dataset relates to people, are there limits on the retention of the data associated with the instances (e.g., were individuals told their data would be retained for a fixed period and then deleted)?

rubrics_metrics.name: Version control
rubrics_metrics.description: Will older versions of the dataset continue to be supported/hosted/maintained? If so, describe how obsolescence will be communicated to dataset consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: If others want to extend/augment/build on/contribute to the dataset, is there a mechanism for them to do so? If so, will these contributions be validated/verified? Is there a process for communicating/distributing these contributions to dataset consumers?

rubrics_metrics.name: Other comments (Maintenance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any additional commentary related to maintenance.
